interaction_motion.evidence: hover.png and focus.png were not captured. From CSS/JS: .rv and IntersectionObserver are gone. Sole entrance is .pane 650ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1). Feedback transition is 150ms but only on .btn,.link,.tel,.nav a. :active exists on .btn, .btn-ghost, .menu, .contact .btn only. Previous .menu/.bar/fields hover+active+150ms is only partly fixed.

issues.problem: Previous issue only partly fixed: hover colors exist, but the requested 150ms background/color transition is not on these selectors. .bar a and form fields have no :active.

issues.fix: Add :active on each: .nav a:active,.tel:active,.mark:active,.link:active{color:var(--deep)} .foot nav a:active,.phones a:active{opacity:.7}.
